fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2016 Nissan Versa Note hatchback.
findings: Grey paint looks clean but somewhat flat, with a light dusty film on the rear hatch and bumper
Small sticker residue or decal on the lower rear hatch near the license plate
Plastic wheel covers look a bit dull
Interior looks tidy; front floor mat shows some light lint and dust
Headlights look reasonably clear, with no heavy yellowing visible
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Versa Note and it looks well kept. The grey paint is a little flat and the rear hatch has some dust and a sticker spot near the plate that a wash and wax would clean up nicely. We do pre-sale details that come to you, inside and out. Would you like a quote?
